The audit-log test was skipped, so the trace is incomplete (the record calls this PARTIAL). The ticket goal also failed: invoice-copy tickets fell 7.5 percent against a target of at least 30 percent (the record calls this rejected), while billing-dispute tickets did not rise.

**Why it matters:** If issue #88 is closed as done, the record will say audit logging works in production when no test has ever passed for it. The missed ticket target is evidence for a decision about the feature's worth, but it is not that decision: 1,310 account owners used the download 1,840 times.
